name: Public Safety Officer Standards and Training Council
notes: Official Montana DOJ page explicitly assigns certification, recertification, suspension and revocation to the council.

name: Police Standards Advisory Council
notes: Council establishes standards governing Nebraska law enforcement certification and revokes certificates. Abbreviation verified at https://ncc.nebraska.gov/annual-continuing-education .

name: Nevada Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training
notes: Official homepage identifies POST as regulatory agency and governing authority for peace officer basic and professional certification.

name: New Hampshire Police Standards and Training Council
notes: Official state occupational licensing publication identifies council, certification role and website. PSTC abbreviation and decertification role also verified in https://www.pstc.nh.gov/publications/documents/annual-report-fy-2023.pdf . Homepage direct fetch returned 403; official indexed documents remain accessible.

name: Police Training Commission
notes: Official OAG page states officers require active licenses issued by PTC. Current 2026 initial and renewal applications verified at https://www.njoag.gov/about/divisions-and-offices/office-of-public-integrity-and-accountability-home/police-training-commission/ptc-forms/ . Main commission page direct fetch returned 403; official indexed pages support identity and role.

name: Law Enforcement Certification Board
notes: Board issues or renews officer certification. Separate New Mexico Law Enforcement Standards and Training Council and academy appear on same official site; do not substitute them for certification board. Abbreviation verified on board homepage.

name: New York State Division of Criminal Justice Services
notes: DCJS maintains officer registry and administers training certificate invalidation. Municipal Police Training Council sets standards and advises commissioner; official council page reproduces Executive Law 841 assigning certification issuance to commissioner: https://boards.criminaljustice.ny.gov/municipal-police-training-council . Select DCJS as certifying agency under one-authority scope.

name: North Carolina Criminal Justice Education and Training Standards Commission
notes: Selected police certification commission. Official page says Criminal Justice Standards Division administers commission certification programs covering sworn police officers. Separate Sheriffs' Education and Training Standards Commission exists; one record does not represent that separate commission. No abbreviation invented.

name: North Dakota Peace Officer Standards and Training Board
notes: Official licensing application gives board name and abbreviation. Official homepage has 2026 POST Board meeting and licensing resources.

name: Ohio Peace Officer Training Commission
notes: Official exam completion document identifies commission as issuer of peace officer certificates. Official academy page distinguishes Commission staff, who oversee certification standards, from Academy staff: https://ohioattorneygeneral.gov/Law-Enforcement/Ohio-Peace-Officer-Training-Academy . Website is commission resources within shared academy site.

name: Council on Law Enforcement Education and Training
notes: Official state agency profile explicitly assigns peace officer certification standards to CLEET.

name: Department of Public Safety Standards and Training
notes: Official department criminal justice page provides basic certification, maintenance and professional standards programs; department issuance also explicit at https://www.oregon.gov/dpsst/CJ/Pages/UpperCerts.aspx .

name: Municipal Police Officers' Education and Training Commission
notes: Commission manages municipal police officer certification. Municipal scope is explicit; do not present as certification authority for every Pennsylvania law enforcement role.

name: Rhode Island Police Officers Commission on Standards and Training
notes: Commission name and POST abbreviation verified on academy's official homepage. Its certification standards authority verified at https://rules.sos.ri.gov/regulations/part/270-30-00-2 . Website is shared academy site. Official page states academy's municipal training/certification scope excludes Providence; do not imply universal coverage.

name: South Carolina Law Enforcement Training Council
notes: Official council page identifies governing council separately from Criminal Justice Academy and uses LETC Orders label. Council certification authority supported by Training Act; current act linked on council page.

name: South Dakota Law Enforcement Officers Standards and Training Commission
notes: January 2025 official AG release identifies full name and certification hearing role; training FAQ verifies certification process. Abbreviation verified in official AG release https://atg.sd.gov/OurOffice/Media/pressreleasesdetail.aspx?id=634 . Website is official training FAQ, not an independent commission domain.

name: Tennessee Peace Officer Standards and Training Commission
notes: Official heading uses singular Officer, while body uses Officers. Commission regulatory role and abbreviation verified; officer certification application linked at https://www.tn.gov/commerce/post/forms-downloads.html .

name: Texas Commission on Law Enforcement
notes: Official commission rules page states statutory regulatory authority over law enforcement agencies and licensees and details licensing rules.

name: Division of Peace Officer Standards and Training
notes: Official about page identifies Division and certification mission in concert with Peace Officer Standards and Training Council. Select administering division under one-authority scope; do not rename it the academy. Application page explicitly distinguishes request for certification from academy admission: https://post.utah.gov/post-application-for-training-and-certification-instructions/ .

name: Vermont Criminal Justice Council
notes: Official current council name, abbreviation, and certification standards mission. Some older training-page text retains former Criminal Justice Training Council wording; current branding omits Training.

name: Virginia Department of Criminal Justice Services
notes: Department page provides certification processes and training/certification records. Do not substitute Virginia Law Enforcement Professional Standards Commission, which is agency accreditation rather than individual officer certification.

name: Washington State Criminal Justice Training Commission
notes: Official page expressly assigns grant, denial, suspension and revocation of officer certification to commission Certification Bureau.

name: Law Enforcement Professional Standards Subcommittee
notes: Official page identifies LEPS Subcommittee of Governor's Committee on Crime, Delinquency and Corrections and LEPS Coordinator as responsible for officer training/certification oversight. Selected subcommittee, not State Police Academy or broad LEPS Program.

name: Law Enforcement Standards Board
notes: Official DOJ board page identifies statutory professional employment/training standards authority and current board procedures; board minutes include officer certification approvals.

name: Wyoming Peace Officer Standards and Training Commission
notes: Official commission homepage identifies full name and abbreviation, retaining certifications mission, and certification reciprocity/decertification resources.
